credit: Milky Way glow: star counts from the ESA mission Gaia (DR3), Gaia Collaboration et al. (2016b, 2023j). This work has made use of data from the European Space Agency (ESA) mission Gaia (https://www.cosmos.esa.int/gaia), processed by the Gaia Data Processing and Analysis Consortium (DPAC, https://www.cosmos.esa.int/web/gaia/dpac/consortium). Funding for the DPAC has been provided by national institutions, in particular the institutions participating in the Gaia Multilateral Agreement.
layout: magic 'GMW1', uint32 nside, uint32 npix, then uint32 n_all[npix], uint32 n_g18[npix], float32 g_flux_sum[npix] (e-/s), little-endian

queries.all: SELECT source_id/35184372088832 AS hpx7, COUNT(*) AS n_all, SUM(phot_g_mean_flux) AS g_flux_sum FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source GROUP BY hpx7
queries.g18: SELECT source_id/35184372088832 AS hpx7, COUNT(*) AS n_g18 FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE phot_g_mean_mag < 18 GROUP BY hpx7

what: Gaia DR3 star counts and summed G flux per HEALPix pixel (NESTED, ICRS); catalogue data, not SPHEREx
